prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph so the running product is the Workspace ground and every agent, code, diff, test, and browser action attaches to what the user can actually see and test.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop web app, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: A persistent left rail, approximately 250px, groups Repositories and nested Workspaces and never moves. The live browser canvas owns nearly two-thirds of the remaining screen. A narrow agent thread sits at right. Code, file diffs, responsive bounds, accessibility findings, console evidence, and agent browser actions appear as focused spatial lenses anchored directly to elements and events in the preview. One inspection lens is active at a time; others recede into slim edge markers. Compact top chrome shows Sylph, repository, branch, preview URL and keyboard search.
Content: Repository `folkhero-web`; Workspaces `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`; active task `Polish the onboarding flow`; browser preview shows a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen with an active responsive-bound overlay on its main form; anchored file `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`; states `Browser checks 4/4`, `Live`, `Agent controlling browser`; agent message `The corrected form now fits at 390px. I’m checking keyboard focus.`
Style/medium: Contemporary browser-native engineering tool, bright and precise. Grounded in responsive inspectors, CSS grid guides, annotation lenses, and spatial debugging, not in a physical metaphor. Workhorse humanist sans, compact tabular numerals, excellent code type.
Composition/framing: The product preview is the undeniable focal surface. Persistent left rail remains clearly visible and groups Repositories above nested Workspaces. Use anchored layers, edge markers, measurement rules, and clean seams rather than bento cards.
Lighting/mood: Daylight-clear, confident, technical, quiet enough for hours of work.
Color palette: chalk #F4F6F2, ink #151A1E, cobalt #2457F5, signal lime #B7F23A, muted cool gray #D8DEE3. Lime is reserved for live/verified state.
Materials/textures: matte browser canvas, crisp ink, translucent inspection overlays, fine measurement rules; no fake physical texture.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Repositories`, `Workspaces`, `folkhero-web`, `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Live`, `Agent controlling browser`.
Constraints: Must read instantly as an agentic remote IDE with persistent left navigation, first-class browser preview, code, skills, diffs, and testing. Dense but calm. Accessible contrast. One active overlay only. No fake claims.
Avoid: control room metaphor, paper metaphor, generic VS Code clone, generic dashboard, rounded bento cards, gradient decoration, glassmorphism, neon glow, oversized typography, marketing hero, device frame, tiny illegible text.
